success_criteria: Separate unknown coverage from confirmed gaps with an explicit map state and named unavailable evidence.
Preserve known evidence, profile exclusions, scope and mapless output.
Do not run an audit for adjacent tasks.

evals.prompt: Use Blindspot to audit the supplied release-note skill against the three-node map below. The only available skill text says: “Draft release notes from merged PRs. Run the checks in `references/qa.md`, then return the draft. Do not publish.” `references/qa.md` is not included. Nodes: `draft.collect` (draft from merged PRs); `qa.verify` (verify the draft's facts before delivery); `publish.upload` (upload the final notes). Give the map table and ranked findings.
expectations: qa.verify is undetermined; evidence names references/qa.md; no ranked coverage gap for qa.verify.
draft.collect is covered and publish.upload is not-applicable.
evals.expected_output: qa.verify is undetermined; evidence names references/qa.md; no ranked coverage gap for qa.verify. draft.collect is covered and publish.upload is not-applicable.
